share_count_basis: 2,205,128,509 Class A plus 342,377,716 Class B outstanding as of 2026-07-24
net_cash_note: Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of $90.26B less $84.0B debt principal. Restricted cash, future leases and contractual commitments are not mechanically netted into equity value.
model_method: 10-year annual owner-cash distributions plus year-10 owner-cash multiple; current net cash added once. Owner-cash margins are analyst estimates, not reported FCF margins. Current capex contains substantial growth investment, so the model does not anchor to the depressed reported FCF margin.

reverse_expectations.framework: Hold Base year-1 revenue at $250B, owner-cash margin path 10% to 20%, 20x terminal multiple and 9% hurdle; solve uniform years-2-to-10 revenue growth.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: Approximately 12.53% annual revenue growth for nine years is demanding for a company of Meta's scale but not demonstrably unrealistic given current high-20s growth. The problem is not a Bull-only price; it is the lack of margin of safety while infrastructure ROIC and regulation remain open gates.

capital_commitment_overlay.treatment: Risk overlay only. These figures span multiple years and may overlap economically with future operations; they are not mechanically deducted from DCF equity value.
